For m=2,n>=3 products of (z,-z) span exactly primitive equal-row units, rank n; for m=n=2 their one cycle square gives primitive rank one image. Thus rho=E, max(m,n),1 respectively, H1 free 2b+E-rho, H2 free b²-rho. Degree 2 particle swap is negative factor exchange, deleted squares -id; rational exact splitting implies H2+=wedge²U, H2-=ker(Sym²U→P_m⊠P_n) with U=W_m⊠W_n, H1+=U, H1-=U⊕coker Phi. Cauchy identities and pointwise multiplication Sym²W_t→P_t (onto for t>=3) yield displayed modules, including thin t=2 exceptions. Independently checked numerical boundary values K2,2:(1,5,0), K2,3:(1,7,1), K3,3:(1,8,7), K3,4:(1,12,24).
